title: Do I need to train to failure?
subtitle: Evidence-based answer to the common question: do i need to train to failure?
evidence_strength: Mixed: Established evidence supports training to failure can increase hypertrophy and strength gains under certain conditions; however, multiple studies show similar outcomes with submaximal effort when volume is matched. Safety data support cautious use with proper supervision and technique.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
